edges.reason: setValue receives the uint256 parameter _v as its only input.
setValue reads msg.sender to attribute the update to the caller identity.
Proxy constructor takes the _target address parameter.
Proxy.setValue receives the uint256 parameter _v.
Proxy.setValue performs the external interface call on target.
Caller constructor takes the _proxy address parameter.
Caller.setValue1 receives the uint256 parameter _v.
Caller.setValue1 performs the low-level call to the proxy.
Caller.setValue2 receives the uint256 parameter _v.
Caller.setValue2 performs the low-level delegatecall to the proxy.
createCaller declares the local caller variable holding the new Caller instance.
createCaller pushes the newly created Caller into the callers state array.
Parameter _v is written into the value state variable of Target.
msg.sender is stored into the sender state variable, making the stored identity caller-controlled.
Parameter _v is forwarded into the external call performed by Proxy.setValue.
Constructor parameter _target is stored into the target state variable of Proxy.
Constructor parameter _proxy is stored into the proxy state variable of Caller.
Parameter _v is ABI-encoded into the low-level call calldata in Caller.setValue1.
Parameter _v is ABI-encoded into the delegatecall calldata in Caller.setValue2.
The low-level call return status is captured in the local success variable of Caller.setValue1.
The delegatecall return status is captured in the local success variable of Caller.setValue2.
The local caller address is pushed into the callers state array of Factory.
Factory constructor assigns the newly deployed Target address to the target state variable.
Factory constructor assigns the newly deployed Proxy address to the proxy state variable.
createCaller deploys a new Caller, invoking its constructor with the stored proxy address.
getSender2 returns the local sender state variable of Caller.
getValue2 returns the local value state variable of Caller.
getSender1 queries the sender view through the proxy interface call.
getValue1 queries the value view through the proxy interface call.
The low-level call in Caller.setValue1 enters the proxy which itself performs an external call, creating a re-entrant external call chain before state checks.
The delegatecall in Caller.setValue2 executes Proxy.setValue code in the Caller context, which then performs an external call while Caller storage is being written.
The external call in Proxy.setValue invokes Target.setValue, which mutates Target state after an externally initiated transfer of control.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _v is the sole input of Target.setValue and carries no independent semantics beyond the function node.
Parameter _target is only consumed by the Proxy constructor assignment to target and should collapse into the constructor node.
Parameter _v of Proxy.setValue is only forwarded to the external call and carries no standalone semantics.
Parameter _proxy of the Caller constructor is immediately stored into proxy and is fully represented by the constructor node.
Parameter _v of Caller.setValue1 is only encoded into calldata and has no independent identity.
Parameter _v of Caller.setValue2 is only encoded into the delegatecall calldata and has no independent identity.
Local caller is a short-lived address produced and pushed inside Factory.createCaller, fully described by that function node.
Local success is the direct return-value witness of the low-level call unsafe operation in Caller.setValue1.
Local success is the direct return-value witness of the delegatecall unsafe operation in Caller.setValue2.
